Strategy: Reward two sweet bands, thirty to forty-five and sixty to seventy-five, while penalizing residuals between eight and twenty-two. This keeps two reusable leftover sizes available instead of one, but the second band may split attention and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (15 if r - item >= 60 and r - item <= 75 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
